note: Measured regression budgets for the HAR-14 fixture pipeline (tests/eval). baseline_ms = the recorded measurement on the reference machine (release profile for the 1M probe, debug for the offline lane); bound_ms = max(3 x baseline, absolute CI-safe floor). Tests fail only when a measurement exceeds bound_ms — egregious regression, never ordinary wall-clock noise. Refresh baselines deliberately when the generator or machine class changes.
